lines.text: Mae is a survivor who rises to the challenges thrown at her. It is a complex portrait of a mid-century woman choosing the life she wants. It’s a look at motherhood and carrying unwanted burdens and a meditation on grief and family. Mae defines the words reinvention and perseverance. What Karin is Reading
